note: Counts are kept separate by unit: source records, eligible cohort, held-out portion, outcome groups, measurements, source scalars and applicable checks are different quantities. No model calls were made.

claims.name: out_popdesc
claims.selector: category=posted outcomes with an analysis population description

claims.name: out_popdesc_meas
claims.selector: category=posted outcomes with measurements and an analysis population description

claims.name: flat_same
claims.selector: category=A: flat count equals the reference denominator

claims.name: flat_b1_diff
claims.selector: category=B1: flat attaches the outcome-level count, row-specific count differs

claims.name: flat_b1_same
claims.selector: category=B1: flat attaches the outcome-level count, row-specific count is the same value

claims.name: flat_b2
claims.selector: category=B2: flat attaches a participant count to values in another unit

claims.name: flat_c_value
claims.selector: category=C: reference not resolvable; flat attaches a value

claims.name: flat_wrong_participant_count
claims.selector: A differs + B1 differs + C with a value
claims.note: attached count is not the most specific participant count, or no safe count exists

claims.name: flat_not_applicable_count
claims.selector: A differs + B1 differs + C with a value + B2
claims.note: adds B2: a participant count attached to values reported in another unit

claims.name: flat_outcomes_lost
claims.selector: category=outcomes with no value rows (absent from the flat export)

claims.name: ret_participant_flow_periods_milestones_and_module_fields_flat
claims.selector: family=participant flow: periods, milestones and module fields

claims.name: ret_participant_flow_periods_milestones_and_module_fields_wh
claims.selector: family=participant flow: periods, milestones and module fields

claims.name: ret_attempted_flat
claims.selector: family=TOTAL: all families the flat export attempts (participant flow, baseline, outcomes)

claims.name: ret_attempted_wh
claims.selector: family=TOTAL: all families the flat export attempts (participant flow, baseline, outcomes)

claims.name: ret_all_flat
claims.selector: family=TOTAL: all in-scope results scalars, including adverse events

claims.name: ret_all_wh
claims.selector: family=TOTAL: all in-scope results scalars, including adverse events

claims.name: fid_scalars
claims.selector: check=in-scope source scalars present in the warehouse with identical text at the same JSON pointer

claims.name: fid_tier_m
claims.selector: check=SQL and independent R tier, rule and denominators agree

claims.name: fid_tier_g
claims.selector: check=SQL and independent R outcome-group tier and rules agree

claims.name: fid_roundtrip
claims.selector: check=results module rebuilt from the warehouse is identical to the source

claims.name: fid_evidence_rows
claims.selector: check=cautious evidence view rows per measurement (duplicate join check)

claims.name: cm_match
claims.selector: category=exactly one baseline group with the same title

claims.name: og000_varies
claims.scope: held-out portion, confirmed cohort; studies with OG000 in two or more outcomes

claims.name: ph_flat_diff_studies
claims.selector: measure=studies with at least one such value

claims.name: ph_flat_diff_outcomes
claims.selector: measure=outcomes with at least one such value

claims.name: ph_flat_diff_top10
claims.selector: measure=such values in the ten studies with the most of them

claims.name: ph_flat_diff_primary
claims.selector: measure=such values among measurements of primary outcomes

claims.name: ph_b1_groups_differ
claims.selector: measure=outcome groups with row-level counts (B1 measurements) in which at least one row's count differs from the outcome-level count

claims.name: ph_analysis_order_values
claims.selector: measure=statistical-analysis values in outcomes with two or more analyses (matched by order in the flat comparison)

claims.name: ph_analysis_order_outcomes
claims.selector: measure=outcomes with two or more analyses
